descriptors.name: simpledao.DemoSignin
descriptors.label: Demo Signin
descriptors.description: Demo/showcase entity rendering a sign-in-style form: an 'Email or username' input, a masked password input with a reveal toggle, and a SUBMIT button. Carries no authentication, session or credential logic.

identifier.name: identifier
identifier.label: Email or username
identifier.description: The 'Email or username' input of the mock — accepts either form, no format rule. Optional for the demo.

password.name: password
password.label: Password
password.description: The 'Password' input of the mock — rendered masked by the PASSWORD view type, whose own latching eye toggles visibility. Optional for the demo.
